purpose: Sanitized public-source record for the #2019 fail-closed clinical-validation decision.

source_records.source: ESMO Clinical Practice Guideline for early breast cancer
source_records.assessment: Does not support using CYP2D6 polymorphisms as a decision aid for adjuvant tamoxifen outside a clinical trial.

source_records.source: Dutch Pharmacogenetics Working Group tamoxifen table
source_records.assessment: Uses a different intermediate-metabolizer alternative-or-dose-escalation presentation from the CPIC row ordering.

source_records.source: MHRA Drug Safety Update: Tamoxifen for breast cancer
source_records.assessment: Limits inhibitor avoidance to potent inhibitors where possible and describes genotype-outcome evidence as mixed or inconclusive.
The later report expands or reanalyzes the earlier prospective dose-escalation study; these are not independent clinical-outcome validation cohorts.

decision: The two-independent-source gate for displaying CYP2D6/tamoxifen treatment, dose, or inhibitor instructions is not met. Retain CPIC rows only as audit provenance and withhold new and persisted prescribing alerts.
